resources.string: Counts the reels and shorts you watch in Instagram and YouTube, and how long you spend on them. It only checks which screen is open. It does not read your messages, posts or what is in a reel. If you turn on YouTube study mode, it also reads the channel name of the YouTube video you open, to compare it with your list. If you turn on Pause before opening, it notices when the apps you chose open, to show a short breathing pause first (it reads nothing in those apps). Nothing leaves your phone.
